results.description: a half-wave rectifier: a source vi(t) = 10 sin(120*pi*t) V drives a single diode in series with a 2.2 kOhm load resistor to ground. Use 1N4001 diodes with a realistic .model card (not an ideal diode). Show several 60 Hz cycles in a transient analysis. Harness requirements: name the output node (top of the load) 'out'.

attempts.netlist:
Half-wave rectifier with 1N4001 diode
Vin 1 0 SIN(0 10 60 0 0)
D1 1 out 1N4001
Rload out 0 2.2k
.model 1N4001 D(IS=14.11n RS=0.033 N=1.984 BV=75 IBV=10u CJO=25.89p TT=5.7u)

.control
tran 50u 50m
print v(1) v(out)
.endc

.end

results.description: a double diode clipping circuit: vi(t) = 5 sin(6280 t) V drives the output node through a 15 kOhm series resistor. From the output to ground there are two diode-plus-battery branches: one clips the positive half-cycle using a 1.5 V source (V1), the other clips the negative half-cycle using a second 1.5 V source (V2). Use 1N4001 diodes with a realistic .model card (not an ideal diode). Show a few cycles in a transient analysis. Harness requirements: name the input node 'in' and the output node 'out'.

attempts.netlist:
* Double Diode Clipping Circuit with 1N4001 Diodes
V1 in 0 SIN(0 5 1000 0 0)
R1 in out 15k
D1 out a D1N4001
Va a 0 DC 1.5
D2 b out D1N4001
Vb b 0 DC -1.5

.model D1N4001 D(IS=14.11n RS=33.9m N=1.984 BV=75.27 IBV=10u CJO=25.89p VJ=0.6376 M=0.3782 TT=5.7us)

.control
tran 10u 5m
print v(in) v(out)
.endc

.end

spec_check.target: positive clip = 1.9 .. 2.3 V; negative clip = -2.3 .. -1.9 V
spec_check.measured: positive clip: 1.991 V; negative clip: -1.991 V

results.description: a diode clamping circuit: a 10 V peak-to-peak, 1000 Hz square wave with zero DC offset drives a 0.1 uF series capacitor to the output node; a 68 kOhm resistor and a diode go from the output node to ground. The diode is oriented so the output is clamped positive (the output waveform is shifted up so it sits almost entirely above 0 V). Use 1N4001 diodes with a realistic .model card (not an ideal diode). Run the transient long enough to reach steady state. Harness requirements: name the output node 'out'.

attempts.netlist:
* Diode clamping circuit - positive clamp with 1N4001
Vin in 0 PULSE(-5 5 0 1n 1n 0.5m 1m)
C1 in out 0.1uF
R1 out 0 68k
D1 out 0 D1N4001

.model D1N4001 D(IS=14.11n RS=0.0648 N=1.984 BV=75 IBV=10.0u CJO=25.89p VJ=0.751 M=0.4319 TT=5.76u)

.control
tran 5u 40m
print v(out)
.endc

.end

spec_check.target: clamped low level = -1 .. -0.2 V; high level = 8.5 .. 10 V; average level = 3.8 .. 5.2 V
spec_check.measured: clamped low level: -9.669 V; high level: 1.002 V; average level: -4.464 V

results.description: a full-wave bridge rectifier: a ground-referenced source vi(t) = 10 sin(120*pi*t) V drives a bridge of four diodes, and a 2.2 kOhm load resistor is connected across the bridge output (the load floats; neither end is ground). Use 1N4001 diodes with a realistic .model card (not an ideal diode). Show several 60 Hz cycles in a transient analysis. Harness requirements: name the load's positive terminal node 'outp' and its negative terminal node 'outn'.

attempts.netlist:
Full-wave bridge rectifier with 1N4001 diodes, floating 2.2k load

.control
    tran 20u 50m
    print v(vin) v(outp) v(outn) v(outp,outn)
.endc

Vin vin 0 SIN(0 10 60)

D1 vin outp D1N4001
D2 0 outp D1N4001
D3 outn vin D1N4001
D4 outn 0 D1N4001

Rload outp outn 2.2k

.model D1N4001 D(IS=14.11n RS=0.0562 BV=75 IBV=5u CJO=25.89p M=0.5 N=1.65 TT=5.76u)

.end

results.description: an inverting active low-pass filter with a passband gain of -10 (20 dB) and a -3 dB cutoff frequency of 1 kHz (within 5%), built around a 741-style op-amp modelled as a subcircuit with finite open-loop gain and bandwidth (not an ideal source), powered from +/-15 V; include an AC analysis. Harness requirements: name the input node 'in' and the output node 'out'; input source with AC magnitude 1.

attempts.netlist:
* Inverting active low-pass filter with 741-style op-amp subcircuit
.subckt opamp741 inp inn out vcc vee
Egain n1 0 inp inn 200000
Rp n1 n2 1k
Cp n2 0 3.183e-5
Eout out 0 n2 0 1
.ends opamp741

Vin in 0 AC 1
Vcc vcc 0 15
Vee vee 0 -15

Rin in n1 1k
Rf n1 out 10k
Cf n1 out 1.5915e-8

X1 0 n1 out vcc vee opamp741

.control
ac dec 20 1 1meg
print frequency vdb(out) vp(out)
.endc

.end
